deviations_from_card: Coupled files beyond the write set: docs/spec/contract.md (method row + LedgerSummary shape), packages/contract/src/generated/results/* (the per-result codegen now regenerates every result module; all but LedgerSummary.{js,d.ts} only renumber validator ids, which is most of the line count), apps/console/budgets/perf.json (brain.l1 rpc line + ledger.summary: 1 with a dated why; the rpc gate fails any unlisted method). Engine.tsx's per-row Cost column shows '–' for an uncosted row instead of $0. The Layer1 flag with the summary reads 'Newest tournament · lanes drawn from the first pages only' so the sibling-owned perf/pages.tsx ready matcher (/first pages only/) needed no edit. Two commits, not three: types+daemon+contract regen went in one locked commit (the contract check compares the schema to the Rust types, so splitting would leave main red); console in the second. Console tests and implementation in one commit (the tests need testgen's ledger.summary answer). Rust tests were red on the assertion before the implementation but were committed with it.
notes: Acceptance 8 card cases: daemon 4 (in 2 e2e tests, both red before: method_not_found), console 4 (Engine whole totals, Layer1 HUD/lamps/flag, error fallback, invalidation); plus one extra console cost case (red before: '$0.6666' vs '$1.20 + 3,000 uncosted').
